answer: A concrete anti-sybil mechanism is beacon-anchored proof of work for identity. Before an agent can earn, it must publish a fresh solution tied to the current epoch's randomness, plus a bond that is slashed if peers catch it vouching for clones. Minting one fake agent therefore costs a new puzzle and a new bond, so a thousand puppets mean a thousand times the price. Reputation accrues only toward a distant horizon of verified work, like yarrow that must overwinter before it flowers. If swarming ever looks cheap, the summit of real standing is still earned, never minted.
